turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, am I speaking with the account holder? This is Marcus Ellery from the fraud prevention team at Northbridge Savings. I'm showing three attempted transfers in the last twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh god, seriously? I haven't made any transfers.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's what the flag suggests. I can stop the third one, but it clears in about four minutes and I can only hold it while we're on the line.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, okay. What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our systems flagged this automatically, case reference 8841-C. First, are you somewhere you can talk freely?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I'm at home. Sorry, this is just a lot.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Completely understandable. To pull up the right record I need the last four digits of the account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. The safest step now is moving the balance to a protected holding account while we investigate. I'll read out the details.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I not call the bank first or something?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome to, though the transfer would clear before you got through. You can reach me directly on 555-0142 if we get cut off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, okay, let's just do it now. Go ahead.
